summary: All KJV quotes are verbatim (Exo 12:3,5,6,12,13,22,23,30,46; 1 Pet 1:19; John 19:33,36; 1 Cor 5:7), the archetypal-witness narrative facts (9 prior plagues, 4 days under roof, twilight kill, blood on lintel/posts, shut door, unbroken bone) match Exodus 12, and the substitutionary Passover-lamb thread lands soundly on Christ with a grace-anchored, fear-free CTA.
